# Documents whose meaning differs between premailer and this package, with
# the reason. Format: <fixture>  <reason>. Self-ratcheting like the parity
# lists: a line whose document now agrees fails the build until it is removed.
#
# Most are premailer's own behaviour rather than bugs here; the reason says
# which. A few (pseudo-class specificity) are open questions or
# missing features on this side.

at-rules/nested-not-inlined  premailer inlines rules juice keeps in <style>: @media print, :link/:visited, and juice's data-embed blocks
cascade/dup-progressive  premailer keeps only the last of a repeated declaration, dropping the fallback juice keeps for older clients
cascade/pseudo-first-selector  premailer inlines rules juice keeps in <style>: @media print, :link/:visited, and juice's data-embed blocks
cascade/selector-list-ties  premailer's css_parser merges and splits shorthands lossily (border: none becomes border-style: none; margin: 0 auto loses longhands)
comments/in-values  premailer's css_parser merges and splits shorthands lossily (border: none becomes border-style: none; margin: 0 auto loses longhands)

css-inline-suite/benchmarks/big_email_2  premailer's css_parser merges and splits shorthands lossily (border: none becomes border-style: none; margin: 0 auto loses longhands)
css-inline-suite/tests/child_all_selector_complex_dom  premailer parses with libxml2's HTML4 parser, which builds a different tree: it repairs malformed markup, closes <h1> and <p> before block elements, and wraps bare text in <p>
css-inline-suite/tests/child_follow_by_adjacent_selector_complex_dom  premailer parses with libxml2's HTML4 parser, which builds a different tree: it repairs malformed markup, closes <h1> and <p> before block elements, and wraps bare text in <p>
